title: East Main: opening and closing
purpose: Opening and closing checklist for the flagship: who, till float, where the deposit goes.
facts: Doors at 7:30; the early desk shift starts at opening (stories/S03: "a desk shift from opening") and exists since {{@early_desk}} = the Monday of week T-3.
Opening order: alarm, key drop box, voicemail and missed calls, till float 200 USD, front door.
The foreman opens the bays and compressor.

Closing: cars in or locked, keys in the cabinet; till closed with 200 USD left as float; deposit bag in the office safe, banked next morning by slot 3; key drop empty; bays, compressor, lights, alarm.
The alarm code is never written down.

list_items.item: Alarm off. The code is given in person, never written down, and that includes here.
Empty the key drop box first. Each envelope becomes an order before the phones start.
Listen to the voicemail and work the missed-call list: Missed calls and call backs.
Count the till float: $200. Write it on the count sheet.
Coffee on, waiting room lights, front door at 7:30 sharp. People are standing there at 7:25.
Every customer car is inside or locked on the lot, keys in the key cabinet, cabinet locked.
Close the till: Closing the till. Float of $200 stays in the drawer. The rest goes in the deposit bag.
The deposit bag goes in the office safe. Donna banks it the next morning.
Check the key drop box is empty and its slot is clear.
Bay doors down, compressor off (ask the last technician), lights, alarm on.

new_facts: Till float at East Main 200 USD; the deposit goes to the office safe and is banked by slot 3 next morning. The ERP cash_drawer_close expected figure excludes or includes the float consistently with how-to/closing-the-till.md.
